messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey ordered.

message.reasoning:
We need to estimate travel times between those locations. Use the tool "route_estimate_time". We have three scenarios:

1) Start NYC -> Philadelphia (PHL?) -> Washington DC -> Atlanta -> Miami.

2) Start NYC -> Philadelphia? Wait second scenario says if not stopping in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami. So path: NYC->Philadelphia->Washington DC->Miami. But maybe they still start at NYC and pass through Philly then DC then MIAMI. They skip ATL. Yes.

But question: "另外，如果我不停留在亚特兰大，直接从华盛顿特区前往迈阿密，会是多少时间?" Means no stop at Atlanta; so route: NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami.

Third scenario: "最后，如果我从改成从费城出发，停留华盛顿特区，然后抵达迈阿密" means start at Philadelphia instead of New York, but include Washington DC as stop before Miami. So route: Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami.

Thus we call function thrice accordingly.

The function signature expects start_location, end_location, stops array optionally. Default stops includes NYC which seems weird. We'll override.

So first call: start="New York", end="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington DC","Atlanta"].

Second call: start="New York", end="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington DC"]. Third: start="Philadelphia", end="Miami", stops=["Washington DC"].

We'll produce results. Let's do calls.
